column7: F3b: same call site as -001, faulted with a panic instead of a returned error -- correctly turned into a 500 by the real Recovery middleware, but core.UpdateRole's own audit-log write (previously committed synchronously BEFORE permission replacement even ran) survived the panic that failed everything after it, leaving an AuditEvent asserting success behind a 500 response; found by an unattended 10-minute fuzz burst (not a hand-written seed), minimized input saved at server/faultops/testdata/fuzz/FuzzStorageFaultOperations/bdbfad52d4cc7bae; fixed by the same transaction restructuring as -001 (audit only written after commit); see docs/findings/2026-09-21-FINDING-role-update-permission-replace-swallows-storage-errors.md
